  1. Get Started

🔮Unsloth Model Catalog

Unsloth LLMs directory for all Unsloth Dynamic GGUF, 4-bit, NVFP4 models on Hugging Face.

QwenGemmaDeepSeekLlamaMistralGLM

GGUFs let you run models in tools like Unsloth Desktop✨ and llama.cpp. Use Instruct (4-bit) safetensors for inference or fine-tuning via Unsloth.
